get.description: One version (the latest by default). Versions never change, so ETags make reloads cheap.
Events after the cursor ``after`` (at most ``limit``), or with ``tail`` the last ``tail`` events.

New events as they are written: one SSE message per batch, ``{"events": [...], "cursor": n}``.

put.description:
A copy of a paper you have (e.g. paywalled, through your library), as the request body (PDF or HTML).

It goes into the literature stage's inbox; the agent reads it the next time that stage runs.
